name: Indergiri Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Indergiri Finance Ltd provides financial services, investment, and trading in shares[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
IFL is registered as a Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Finance Company. It is in the business of lending to retail Small and Medium Entrepreneurs, individuals, body corporates. It also undertakes investments in equities and derivatives

cons: Stock is trading at 13.0 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -16.8% over last 3 years.
